Refresh an RRP project's analytical product CSVs

Source: R/product-refresh.R
rrp_refresh_products.Rd

Derive the current clinically eligible risk pool, observed accepted-risk trajectories, and operational scope from retained assessment history. The selected completed run has the greatest analytical as_of_time; execution created_at and then run_id break ties. A later-executed historical backfill does not replace a newer analytical snapshot.

Usage

rrp_refresh_products(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an existing RRP project with initialized analytical state and at least one completed assessment run.

Value

Invisibly, a list with selected_run_id, UTC as_of_time, and named character files containing the three generated CSV paths.

Details

Files are written under state/products/ as current-remaining-risk.csv, remaining-risk-trajectory.csv, and operational-scope-summary.csv. The current-risk file includes clinically eligible provider-failure episodes with a missing probability, never zero or an earlier estimate. Refresh reads history only: it does not run the source mapper or provider, add a run, change retained history, or edit the project-owned app. All files are staged and checked before replacement. Replacement of the three files is not fully atomic if a filesystem error occurs during the final replacement sequence.
